title: It Looked Like Spilt Milk
author: Charles G. Shaw

hero.name: Spilt Milk / White Shape

hero.source_note: The hero is the abstract white silhouette shape itself — no named character. Source a high-contrast white blob/cloud silhouette on blue background from Creative Fabrica or create custom. A simple white cloud silhouette on blue may serve as a reasonable substitute.

character_images_needed: Spilt Milk white silhouette shape on blue background
notes: This book has no named character — the hero is the concept of the white silhouette shape itself. The entire book is built on the repeated phrase 'It looked like...' followed by a shape that resembles a familiar object. Key vocabulary therefore centres on the shapes named (rabbit, bird, tree, flower, angel, ice cream, pig, mitten) and sky/cloud/milk. The 11 fringe words selected prioritise the most frequently named shapes plus the core concept words 'cloud', 'milk', 'sky', and 'white'. Note that 'angel', 'ice cream', 'pig', and 'mitten' were considered but omitted in favour of the most frequently recurring and communicatively functional shapes. The colour 'white' is included as it is the defining visual feature of every shape in the book. Most vocabulary items are already in the existing activity_images or aac_extras libraries (cloud, sky, rabbit, bird, tree, flower, milk, moon, star) which is advantageous for production.
